As with all [[Black equipment#Armour|black armour]], it cannot be made using the [[Smithing]] [[Skills|skill]]. It can be bought at [[Valaine's Shop of Champions]] in the [[Champions' Guild]] for 1,372 [[coins]]. It can also be obtained as a [[Treasure Trails]] reward. A black full helm is used in [[King's Ransom]] and, if you're part of the [[Black Arm Gang]], [[Heroes' Quest]]. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = 0 |aslash = 0 |acrush = 0 |amagic = -6 |arange = -3 |dstab = 12 |dslash = 13 |dcrush = 10 |dmagic = -1 |drange = 12 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = head |image = [[File:Black full helm equipped male.png|170px]] |altimage = [[File:Black full helm equipped female.png|170px]] }} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black full helm}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black full helm}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black full helm}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 21 April 2021 |update = Fishing Trawler Improvements and Equipment Rebalance: Part One |change = The full helmet's ranged attack bonus has been decreased from -2 to -3. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black full helm detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black full helm detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black full helm (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black full helm.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
